verdict.rationale: Pandoc ships an official, vendor-maintained Haskell library alongside the CLI (pandoc-docs-17), and it is a versioned package: in 3.0 the 'pandoc' package stopped providing the executable (pandoc-comm-18). That is one official programmatic library, but only for Haskell; the evidence shows no official bindings or client libraries for other mainstream languages, including for its HTTP server mode. missing for 10: official client libraries for mainstream languages (Python, JavaScript, Java, etc.), client SDKs for pandoc-server, documented versioning and maintenance policy for libraries, independent corroboration of library usage.
